title: Indigenous music of Australia - Wikipedia
text: Traditional instruments such as the didjeridu and clapsticks are commonly used, giving the music a distinctive feel. title: Tahitian Traditional - Melodigging
text: Music and dance were tightly woven with oral poetry, chiefly lineages, and community rites. Core instruments—especially the slit-log drum (toʻere), the large pahu, the higher-pitched faʻatete, and the conch shell—anchored dances like the fast ʻoteʻa and the mimetic aparima.
